title: R90S 1973 Legend (Pro Spec)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Urban Roadster capability, the BMW Motorrad R90S 1973 Legend (Pro Spec) delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
